sampling: Each rank uses a mixed task batch; global 24 examples contain eight T, eight D, eight E. Balance remains computed over each complete mixed rank batch.
initialization_setting: Fine-tune the published jointly trained XTrack-B reference; this is not an equal-total-training-budget comparison against its original training.
check_data_usage: Only training loader is iterated; no paired check samples or short clips are fetched.
loss_normalization: Per-task local means weighted by local task count/global task count, sum over ranks, equal mean over3 tasks. Keep balance on each complete mixed rank batch.
comparison_role: Repaired fixed-mixed AdamW paired control C
reference_recipe_equivalence: Same configured main-data sampling, seed, loss and initialization; bitwise-identical augmentations across variants/epochs are not claimed.
